Do you have a passion for technology and want to contribute to a smoothly running production environment? In this role as a maintenance operator, you ensure that machines continue to perform optimally. You will join a close-knit technical team where safety, quality, and cooperation are key. This position is ideal for a junior electromechanic who wants to further develop skills in industrial maintenance.

You will join a modern production environment where technology plays a crucial role. The company invests in machinery, safety, and employee training. The working atmosphere is collegial and professional, offering room to grow and learn within a stable team of technicians.
Wij bieden
• A position in a 2-shift system within a stable production environment
• Attractive salary between €18 and €20/21 per hour, depending on experience
• Shift premiums of 6% on top of the salary
• Meal vouchers of 9 € per working day
• Hospitalization insurance
• Bicycle leasing
• Bonus system (CAO 90)
• Training and career development opportunities to further expand your technical knowledge
• You will work in a technical team of approximately 8 colleagues (replacement position)
Ready to take the next step in your technical career? Apply now via oudenaarde@proman-jobs.be
Wij vragen
• Technical degree in electromechanics or equivalent through experience
• Initial experience in industrial maintenance is a plus, but motivated juniors are also welcome
• Strong interest in mechanical maintenance (electricity as complementary knowledge)
• Insight into industrial processes and the interaction between machines
• You work safely, accurately, and follow procedures correctly
• You are stress-resistant and can react quickly in case of breakdowns
• You communicate well and enjoy working in a team
• You speak English and French
• You are eager to learn and open to new technologiesHet bedrijfOur client is an international producer based in Kruisem, specializing in the processing and valorization of by-products from the food industry. • Fluent in Dutch and English.

Datashift, a rapidly expanding team dedicated to providing data-driven solutions for business challenges, is seeking a talented Analytics Engineer to join us.

 
Your responsibilities 
In this role, you will play a crucial part in translating client needs into sustainable data solutions, encompassing ETL processes, Infrastructure as Code, interfaces, and pipelines.

• Designing data solutions, balancing cost and maintainability.
• Collaborating with Data Scientists, BI specialists, and Business Consultants to deliver value.
• Staying abreast of the latest developments in data technology and actively sharing knowledge with colleagues.
• Monitoring the quality and stability of data solutions.
• Mentoring and coaching other Analyticals Engineer. 
Your qualifications
 

Do you have 4 to 6 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a cloud environment? Do you possess a passion for approaching projects from an end-to-end data perspective? We are delighted to receive your personal application and we’ll contact you for an interview and a (virtual) cup of coffee.

 

• You can adeptly apply diverse data modeling styles and collaborate with our customers to develop the optimal data model for their needs.
• You grasp data structures & formats and are familiar with popular (cloud) data warehouses.
• You navigate DBT with expertise, effortlessly crafting a new project, playing with all the DBT-blocks to build a castle from the ground up.
• Deep knowledge of SQL;
• You have a proven track record of effortlessly incorporating DevOps best practices such as CI/CD, IaC, and unit testing. CI/CD, which may sound like a secret code, is a realm you navigate with ease. You not only grasp its steps but can also articulate why it's indispensable for any data project. Moreover, you possess the skills to autonomously set it up.
• You approach challenges with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset, and you're well-acquainted with agile methodologies and collaborative teamwork.
• Experience with Docker and PySpark is a plus;
• Experience with dataframe API’s in Python (Panda’s, Polars, ...);
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French and English.

As a reach truck driver, you are one of the most important links in the Katoen Natie warehouse in Ghent. You are responsible for storing and preparing valuable materials. Using the reach truck, you regularly stock goods on high racks. This requires an eye for detail and safety.

 
Profile
• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves
• You work 60% on the reachtruck and 40% other tasks in the warehouse
• You ideally have extensive experience with the reach truck (at least 1 year); a certificate is a plus, but not a must
• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, it is important that you speak and understand Dutch or English or French
• You start in a day shift for training and then fulltime night shift

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in the storage, transport, and handling of goods. The company is located in the city of Ghent in Belgium and has branches all over the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management.

Katoen Natie Gent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has a strong connection with the local community. The company has undertaken various initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

For a warehouse specialized in motorcycles, we are looking for a technically skilled Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) & Assembly Associate. In this role, you are responsible for preparing, inspecting, and assembling motorcycles before they are delivered to the customer. You carry out precise quality checks, ensure correct assembly of components, and guarantee that each motorcycle meets the required quality standards.You will work in a two-shift system and join a dynamic environment where quality, safety, and teamwork are central.

Do you recognize yourself in the characteristics below? Then get in touch with us quickly!

You can easily understand and use English or Dutch in the workplace.

You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

You have a technical mindset and are comfortable working with tools.

You are flexible and able to handle stress.

You don’t shy away from Saturday work or occasional overtime.

You have a passion for motorcycles, machinery, or technology.

Experience in assembly, PDI, or a similar technical role is a plus.

As a Back-up Team Leader, you act as the right hand of the Team Leader. In their absence, you take full responsibility for the daily operations and ensure that warehouse activities run smoothly and efficiently. Together, you maintain high quality standards, productivity, and a positive working environment.

Your responsibilities:

• Support and deputize for the Team Leader in daily operational management
• Coordinate, guide, and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety performance
• Report progress, results, and any operational issues to management
• Proactively contribute to process improvements and efficiency initiatives

Do you reconisze yourself in the items listed below:

• experience in logistics or warehouse operations
• leadership skills with a hands-on mentality
• Communicates in both Dutch and English
• flexible

As an operator, you play an important role in the production process of metal components. You work with modern machines and ensure that each piece is bent and cut according to the correct specifications. Quality and precision are central to your job.

You start your day by preparing and positioning the pieces. Next, you set up the machine correctly, start it up, and monitor the entire production process. You thoroughly check each finished product to make sure it meets quality standards. You work in a structured and accurate way, and you'll have the chance to learn a lot on the job.

Are you interested in working with metal and eager to learn the trade? This is your opportunity! Apply quickly and become our new operator.

• You speak and understand English well, basic Dutch is a plus
• You are motivated, accurate, and eager to learn
• Experience in production is an advantage but not required
• You are available to work full time (40 hours/week)
• You can perform quality checks and enjoy hands-on work

jobs.description:
Title
Welder – Two-Shift Work
Job description
Looking for a full-time welding role in automotive parts manufacturing? This opportunity in Zwevegem starts as an interim assignment with the option of permanent employment. You’ll work with tube products and a range of materials.
A tube-products manufacturer
The company specializes in manufacturing tube products.
Your role
• Weld aluminum, stainless steel, and iron to create strong, precise joints.
• Carry out accurate welding work on tubes for different applications.
• Use TIG or semi-automatic welding equipment for the work at hand.
• Check your work carefully and make sure the finish meets quality specifications.
You’ll work in a two-shift schedule.
Company profile
Forum Jobs connects talent and companies through a personal approach and broad sector knowledge. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing a human touch to the recruitment process and helping people find opportunities that fit.

You’ll feel at home in this role if careful, skilled welding and pride in a quality finish are your kind of work.

• Your experience as a welder gives you a solid foundation, especially if you’ve worked with aluminum, stainless steel, and iron.
• TIG welding feels familiar to you, and you’re comfortable working with semi-automatic welding equipment.
• You notice the small details that make a difference and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, adapt flexibly, and make safety a priority for yourself and those around you.
• You can communicate in English, Dutch, or French, and can provide a reference from a former employer.
